_doc: #0303 reviewed source/identity refusal codes. New codes fail tests/test_0303_refusal_allowlist.py until listed here with Jarvis' OK. Categories: uv, anti_injection, frozen, state, not_a_refusal.

application_ingress_unverified.why: No live owner request frame: caller is a friend/visitor/group turn, a guest-born process, or not in the owner session tree (owner_local admits the owner's own jobs since 0.30.3). Actionable text via humane/plaza template.

automation_grant_owner_turn.why: 0304 A3: an automation send grant (agentj automation grant) is requested/widened only in the owner's own turn (Web App, owner terminal, verified owner channel); a webhook/task/guest/group/friend turn asking for its own wider card is refused with no card and told to ask the owner. Same-owner/friend/wechat/assist/chain turns are refused here too (security r1 F13). Security impl r1 L1: the CLI `agentj automation revoke` over elevate.sock is refused with this code outside the owner's turn too (the CLI list then shows counts only; the phone's Settings revoke is unchanged). Siblings, not listed because the scanner word filter does not match them: automation_grant_required/_stale/_invalid (scope results carrying the exact extend command; _stale also covers deleted target, Stop everything and a changed SMTP account), automation_grant_domain_refused (F2: a public suffix or consumer mailbox domain may only be granted as exact addresses), automation_grant_context (F13: no issuance inside a goal grant, batch approval or bounded-plan continuation), automation_grant_idn_ambiguous (impl r1 M2: a domain IDNA 2003 and UTS-46 would map differently must be typed as its exact punycode).

awaiting_owner_verification.why: Completion recovery waits for the owner to verify a result; a state, not a source refusal.

backend_binary_untrusted.why: Native scheduler backend binary failed its integrity check; host safety, not a judgement on the requester.

caller.why: capability_pause / self_compact: caller process is not the current main conversation (another session or guest process).

corrupt_original.why: Scheduler control: original record unreadable; data integrity, name matched by the scanner filter.

fresh_owner_uv_required.why: Function runs a UV-list operation; needs the owner's fresh fingerprint card.

friend_handoff_unverified.why: ADR-0306-friend-handoff-mail: `agentj mail send` in a friend_task turn whose host-held 「交给主 Agent 来办」 handoff record (serve._friend_main → friend_handoff.mint, keyed by the F3 nonce, bound to that Send) is not live — replayed onto another Send, never minted, past its TTL, or the friend removed/blocked; no card, nothing sent. A live handoff gets the owner's UV card for third-party mail and the owner-only pass.

group_source.why: Request text came from a group chat, forwarded/external data or an unverified sender posing as the owner; owner TG/WeChat/verified mail are owner since 0.30.3 (R1); since 0.30.6 (#0304) `agentj mail send` whose every final To/Cc/Bcc is an owner address (slot 0 / owner allowlist rows, exact match) passes from any turn.

level_harness.why: Full-access allow label (harness level), not a refusal.

missing_source.why: Bounded plan input validation: a move/copy step without a source path.

no_owner_address.why: Owner has no mail address configured; actionable setup state.

no_owner_session.why: No owner session exists to deliver to; availability.

not_owner.why: Official assist / admin action requested by a non-owner identity.

owner_at_computer_required.why: Local files: switching a protected root needs the owner at the computer (pairing-level local presence).

owner_denied_before.why: The owner already denied this exact request; repeat is not re-asked.

owner_grant.why: Signed owner grant is required/used (frozen signed-grant layer).

owner_grant_scope.why: A same-owner (OTG) task asked for a UV step (uv_list.required / #537 list, or a UV card such as a plaza secret grant) outside its signed grant (frozen signed-grant layer); non-UV steps follow the ordinary same-owner rules since 0304 A2-2.

owner_hosts_commands_unavailable.why: Owner host-commands feature not available on this host.

owner_later.why: First-run checklist label: owner chose later.

owner_only.why: Admin operation requested by a non-owner identity.

owner_phone_required.why: WeChat setup/claim needs the owner's paired phone (setup is UV-backed); not used for owner channels' ordinary requests.

owner_required.why: Friend report / WeChat pending needs an owner source; guests refused.

owner_scope.why: Approval scope tied to the owner's signed card (frozen card envelope).

owner_signature_required.why: Subscription change needs the owner's signature (frozen signing layer).

owner_source.why: Secret transfer requested by a non-owner source; secrets never move on guest text.

owner_turn_required.why: Local files root change from a non-owner turn.

owner_unavailable.why: Owner unavailable for the subscription confirmation.

owner_unreachable.why: OpenCode start: owner cannot be reached for a decision.

paired_owner_required.why: Completion recovery needs a paired owner device (pairing layer).

peer_unverified.why: Caller pid unreadable or not provable as the owner session (fail closed); owner_local fallback admits the owner's own jobs since 0.30.3.

provenance.why: core/hostside: request provenance is a guest/group/external source.

same_owner_required.why: Peer action allowed only for a same-owner device; strangers refused.

same_owner_run_directly.why: Guidance for same-owner turns: run steps directly; UV steps pop the owner card. Not a block.

source.why: capability_pause: pause requested from a guest/group source.

source_changed.why: Local files: the request source changed mid-flight (another turn took over).

source_denied.why: Privacy broker / feedback: verified origin is suspicious or a guest; owner_local covers the owner's own jobs.

source_exists_destination_absent_require.why: Bounded plan input validation for move steps.

source_has_pending_control.why: Scheduler: source job already has a pending control; state.

task_plan.why: Batch action list from a guest/group/scheduled turn; message tells the agent to run steps directly (UV steps pop the owner card).

trusted_owner_task_required.why: Bounded plan from a non-owner task.

unreadable_or_unverified.why: Skill link target unreadable; file integrity.

untrusted_source.why: Capability dispatch from a guest/group/external source; owner channels are owner since 0.30.3 (R1).

untrusted_turn.why: Heartbeat/accounts/iMessage action from a guest/group/external turn; owner channels are owner since 0.30.3 (R1).

untrusted_turn_live.why: Shared session: untrusted (foreign) input is live in the native turn.

unverified_plan_producer.why: Action list not tied to the owner's current turn; message offers running steps directly.

unverified_service.why: Service identity check for a host service socket failed; host integrity.

workflow_source.why: Workflow mail from a non-owner/unverified source.
